authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed controller source, exact mission/world/model identities, bounded command contracts, watchdog behavior, and evaluator-owned simulation evidence.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues and mission specifications with explicit simulation, safety, resource, and physical-transfer acceptance criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Deterministic simulator state, replayable action/sensor logs, watchdog/collision checks, hardware-in-loop tests, and independent physical safety review.
authority.deployment_authority: Explicit operator and hardware interlock authority; simulation or model output never authorizes physical actuation.

data.retention: Mission specifications, simulator worlds, controller identities, trajectories, failures, safety evidence, and transfer results remain version controlled.
data.deletion: Unsafe, obsolete, or invalid controller artifacts are revoked from active execution and retained only as historical evidence.
data.secret_storage: Hardware credentials, network keys, live camera data, and private home telemetry remain outside Git.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Controller candidates, device grants, and actuation profiles are independently revocable; physical emergency stop and watchdog remain outside agent control.

stabilization.summary: Bind mission, world, robot, controller, physics, seed, observation, action, and evaluator identities in retained receipts.
Add replayable sensor/action logs, discrepancy records, hardware-in-loop qualification, and explicit emulator/simulator versus physical status.
Keep emergency stop, watchdog, collision envelope, and actuation grants independent of model and agent behavior.
